东荒大陆南域边陲。
青阳城萧家，破旧的小院里，一个五六岁的小女孩端着有两个缺口的碗，脏兮兮的小脸有些红肿，身上的衣服打满了补丁。
“无邪哥哥，吃药糊糊了。”
小女孩吱呀推开破洞漏风的门，小心翼翼捧着碗里的药糊糊走到简陋的床前。
“月瑶，他们是不是又打你了？”
看到她脸上红红的指痕，君无邪咬了咬牙，双手撑着床板，挣扎着想要坐起，可又重重跌落了下去。
“没有，月瑶不小心摔的。”小女孩眼圈微红，勺了一勺药糊糊喂到君无邪嘴边，甜甜地说道：“无邪哥哥乖哦，吃了药糊糊就会好起来啦。”
君无邪鼻尖一酸，一口一口吃了起来。
就在这时，一个有些尖锐的声音在院里响起。
“君无邪，萧旭大哥来探望你了，还不快出来迎接？”
两个少年出现在院落里，一人站在门前，一人踱步而入，目光扫了一圈，落在床上的君无邪身上，一扶额头说道：“嗨，我怎么就忘了，你已经瘫了，终生残废，啧啧！”
“萧奇，你走开！”小月瑶紧张地拦住萧奇，说道：“你们这些坏人不准欺负他！”
“小贱婢，滚开！”
萧奇一扒拉，小月瑶摔在地上，撞破额头，鲜血直流。
“月瑶！”君无邪的眼睛一下子红了，死死盯着萧奇：“你他妈冲我来！”
“冲你来？”
萧奇看着君无邪那野兽般嗜血的眼神，心里莫名的升起一丝寒意。
微微一怔后回过神来，他意识到自己竟被一个残废吓到了，不禁恼怒，嘲讽道：“怎么？你以为自己还是半年前那个压得青阳城同代抬不起头的萧家少主？”
萧奇冷笑着摸了摸下巴说道：“你难道不知道，你这个少主早已名存实亡，不然家族怎么会断了你的奉钱，任由我们将你扔到这个破烂后院？”

这时门口的萧旭来到床前：“唔，你的命可真硬啊。”
“不许你们碰无邪哥哥！”
小月瑶不顾一切冲上去死死抱住萧旭的腿，使劲往外拖。
“滚！”
萧旭腿一震，小月瑶一个踉跄退了好几步，摔在地上。
“月瑶！”
君无邪想要爬起来，可身体不听使唤。
“你很愤怒？”萧旭畅快大笑：“愤怒就对了，可是你又能把我们怎么样呢？”
“萧旭！萧奇！”
君无邪紧紧咬着牙。
“嘿，你现在的表情像极了半年前我杀你时的样子。”萧旭俯身凝视着身体因愤怒而颤抖的君无邪，嘴角勾起一抹弧度：“我很好奇啊，当时明明刺穿了你的心脏，你居然还能活下来！”
君无邪眼角剧烈跳动，死死盯着萧旭。
半年前的那一幕浮现在脑海。
在青阳城外龙岭山脉前，他被来自大城市的萧氏宗族的少主，那个自称天命之人的萧天命挖走了混沌神脉，击碎了丹田。
堂兄萧旭竟落井下石，一剑刺穿了他的心脏。
他不知道自己是怎么挺过来的，醒来时就在这张床上了。
他的父亲为了给他治伤，深入山林寻找奇珍药草，却葬身在了凶兽的利爪下。
“以前，你意气风发时，是不是觉得自己高高在上？”萧旭眼神阴冷：“你一个跟随母姓的人，有什么资格做萧家少主？你不过是个野种罢了！”
“滚！”
君无邪冷冷开口。

“啧啧，我就喜欢看你愤怒的模样。”萧旭的阴冷渐渐变成得意：“我今天来是想告诉你，我即将彻底融合萧天命大人赐予的天命灵脉，一举成为天命使者！”
“哦对了，一个月后，大河剑宗与大周王朝会在我们青阳城举办英才选拔赛，胜出者将得到一枚大河海选令，拥有加入大河剑宗的机会！我若得到海选令后杀了你，你说家族元老们会不会惩罚我？”
“唔，看看，看你那不甘却什么该也改变不了，只能瘫在床上无能狂怒的样子，哈哈哈！”

The southern border of the Eastern Barren Continent.
In the shabby courtyard of the Xiao family in Qingyang City, a five or six-year-old girl was holding a bowl with two gaps. Her dirty little face was red and swollen, and her clothes were full of patches.
"Brother Wuxie, I'm confused after taking medicine."
The little girl squeaked open the leaky door, carefully holding the medicine paste in the bowl and walked to the simple bed.
"Yue Yao, did they hit you again?"
Seeing the red finger marks on her face, Jun Wuxie gritted his teeth, supported the bed board with both hands, struggled to sit up, but fell down again.
"No, Yue Yao accidentally dropped it." The little girl's eyes were slightly red. She spooned a spoonful of the medicine paste to Jun Wuxie's mouth and said sweetly: "Brother Wuxie, be good. You will get better after taking the medicine paste."
The tip of Jun Wuxie's nose felt sour, and she started eating bite by bite.
At this moment, a sharp voice sounded in the courtyard.
"Jun Wuxie, brother Xiao Xu is here to visit you, why don't you come out to greet him soon?"
Two teenagers appeared in the courtyard. One stood in front of the door, and the other walked in. His eyes glanced around and landed on Jun Wuxie on the bed. He put his forehead on his hands and said, "Hey, why did I forget that you are paralyzed and will be disabled for life? Tsk tsk!"
"Xiao Qi, go away!" Xiao Yueyao stopped Xiao Qi nervously and said, "You bad guys are not allowed to bully him!"
"You little bastard, get out of here!"
Xiao Qi pulled her away, and Xiao Yueyao fell to the ground, breaking her forehead and bleeding.
"Yue Yao!" Jun Wuxie's eyes suddenly turned red and she stared at Xiao Qi: "You fucking come at me!"
"Coming for you?"
Xiao Qi looked at Jun Wuxie's beast-like bloodthirsty eyes, and felt an inexplicable chill in his heart.
After being stunned for a moment, he came back to his senses. He realized that he had been frightened by a cripple. He couldn't help but get angry and mocked: "What? Do you think you are still the young master of the Xiao family who suppressed your contemporaries in Qingyang City half a year ago?"
Xiao Qi sneered and touched his chin and said: "Don't you know that you, the young master, have long existed in name only? Otherwise, how could the family cut off your financial support and let us throw you into this shabby backyard?"
At this time, Xiao Xu came to the bed at the door: "Well, your life is really tough."
"You are not allowed to touch Brother Wuxie!"
Xiao Yueyao rushed forward desperately and hugged Xiao Xu's leg, dragging it out as hard as she could.
"Get out!"
Xiao Xu's legs shook, and Xiao Yueyao staggered back several steps and fell to the ground.
"Yue Yao!"
Jun Wuxie wanted to get up, but her body refused to obey her orders.
"Are you angry?" Xiao Xu laughed heartily: "It's okay to be angry, but what can you do to us?"
"Xiao Xu! Xiao Qi!"
Jun Wuxie gritted his teeth tightly.
"Hey, your expression now looks exactly like the one when I killed you half a year ago." Xiao Xu leaned over and stared at Jun Wuxie, whose body was shaking with anger. The corner of his mouth curled up: "I'm very curious. I clearly pierced your heart at that time, but you can still survive!"
The corners of Jun Wuxie's eyes twitched violently as she stared at Xiao Xu.
The scene half a year ago came to mind.
In front of the Longling Mountains outside Qingyang City, he was poached by the young master of the Xiao clan from the big city, Xiao Tianming, who claimed to be the man of destiny, to have his Chaos Divine Veins dug away and his Dantian shattered.
Cousin Xiao Xu actually added insult to injury and pierced his heart with a sword.
He didn't know how he got through it and woke up in this bed.
In order to treat his injuries, his father went deep into the mountains and forests to find rare medicinal herbs, but was killed by the claws of a vicious beast.
"In the past, when you were high-spirited, did you feel that you were superior?" Xiao Xu's eyes were cold: "As a person who follows your mother's surname, what qualifications do you have to be the young master of the Xiao family? You are just a bastard!"
"Get out!"
Jun Wuxie spoke coldly.
"Tsk, tsk, I just like to see you angry." Xiao Xu's coldness gradually turned into pride: "I came today to sue you.Let me tell you, I am about to completely integrate the destiny spiritual veins given by Master Xiao Tianming and become the messenger of destiny in one fell swoop! "
"Oh, by the way, in one month, the Dahe Sword Sect and the Great Zhou Dynasty will hold a talent selection competition in our Qingyang City. The winner will receive a Dahe Sea Selection Order and have the opportunity to join the Dahe Sword Sect! If I kill you after getting the audition order, do you think the family elders will punish me? "
"Well, look at you, you are so unwilling but can't change anything, you can only lie on the bed helpless and furious, hahaha! "
